answer_1.quote: ...introduces CLAIR, an LLM-based evaluation measure for image captioning...

answer_2.quote: ...we benchmark against several existing measure of caption similarity. BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR and CIDEr all primarily measure n-gram overlap... we also compare against SPICE, which compares caption parse trees... we also compare against several modern measures, including CLIP-Score...

answer_3.quote: ...convert the caption evaluation problem into a human‑readable text completion task which is solved by the LLM... we ask an LLM to produce a numeric rating and a reason for its score...

answer_4.quote: ...candidate captions are graded by annotators on Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) on a scale of 1 (not relevant) to 5 (very relevant)... the Flickr8K‑Expert dataset contains expert human judgments of quality... human annotators label which caption in the pair is closest to the reference set...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate captions on relevance/correctness scales and choose the preferred caption in pairwise comparisons.
